method:
I worked from pictures first, then checked everything against the geometry in prims.pkl ('bank2', area L2).

1. Looked at bank_L2_overview.png, then rendered the whole level (L2_full.png, 1 m grid, inserts).
2. Rendered 15 zoomed tiles of about 5x5 m (0.5 m grid, inserts and text): rows y 8–13, 3.5–8.5, -1–4, -5.5 to -0.5 and -11.2 to -5.2, crossed with columns x -6.2 to -1.2, -1.6 to 3.4 and 3.2 to 8.4. In each tile I followed every A-WALL line and noted every swing, leaf, door block and gap.
3. Geometry checks:
- Listed all 24 A-DOOR inserts (name, insert point, rotation, scale). For each, I moved its frame, leaf and arc primitives into the door's local frame to get the frame half-width and depth. The four identical 650 louvre blocks were merged under one block name, so I separated them by distance from each insert.
- Set a and b = insert ∓ half-width along the insert's x-axis. Then checked every a and b against the A-WALL end-face lines on both sides: all 24 doors match within 0.1 mm.
- Listed all A-WALL lines and hatches, the S-COLS columns, the 5 'GLASS WALL 2600H' wall blocks, the A-FLOR, A-DETL and A-FLOR-HRAL lines, every swing-sized arc on a non-door layer (only furniture and rack cabinets) and every non-door insert. No door is hidden on another layer.
4. Wall gaps: I checked every short A-WALL end-face line with a script. Each one is explained by an opening end, a column, a junction or a wall that ends in open space. The only doorless gap between two wall ends of one wall line is B2-04.
5. Final check renders: check_full.png (a marker at every opening centre and every glass wall) and six zoomed end-point checks (endcheck_NW, MID, SW, NE, SE, GL), all clean.

Findings:
- No windows on Level 2: there is no glazing in any exterior wall and no A-GLAZ content.
- The east and south facades have louvred swing doors onto an outdoor terrace (railings plus a curved parapet).
- The wealth room is a box of glass walls with one glass door.
- The total is 24 doors and 1 passage.

- B2-01 to B2-08: north block, toilets, rack and F/C.
- B2-09: CSO north door.
- B2-10 and B2-11: stair lobby.
- B2-12 to B2-17: east facade, north to south.
- B2-18 to B2-20: south facade, east to west.
- B2-21 to B2-24: lift hall, lift, pantry and BOH.
- B2-25: wealth room glass door.
